answer: Counterparty diversity blocks sybil clusters. A reward claim needs paid work with 8 distinct counterparties this epoch. An attacker with 100 fakes cannot just trade among its own copies: each fake needs 8 outside partners at a 10 POA fee, so 100 fakes cost 100 x 8 x 10 = 8,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 80 POA once. A river reaches its zenith only when tributaries join it. A jetty likewise stands only on several anchors. Diverse counterparties make trust cheap for one honest agent and ruinous for a copy farm.
